text:
maria: Morning — quick async standup. Pipeline: HealthCo deal in legal review (POC done), NovaRetail final pricing question. Blockers: legal asked about BYOK/KMS integration and proof of data residency, Security asked whether Dedicated can meet client SOC2 plus client-specific log retention. Today: follow up with legal, ping infra for BYOK docs, prep demo. Any heads up?
kevin: HealthCo — legal asked for KMS key lifecycle details and whether we support key rotation by customer. I sent them the KMS integration doc but they want an official snippet for our contract team.
anya: For NovaRetail, pricing is negotiated but they're asking for guaranteed <100ms P99 for chat. Need an Eng SLO confirmation. I'm blocked until we confirm model variant and dedicated capacity cost.
sam_s: @maria @kevin we support BYOK for Dedicated via customer KMS (AWS/GCP). Rotation is supported; we store wrapped keys. I'll attach the architecture snippet.
sam_s: ```
Customer KMS -> wrapped DEK -> HSM/KMS in Redwood Dedicated -> kms:Encrypt/Decrypt
Rotation: rotate DEK, update wrapped key, no downtime
```
lucas: For the SLO ask — if they pick a small seq length and a 2x buffer on reserved capacity we can target 90ms p50 and 120ms p95 in our EU region. P99 at <100ms will need burst+dedicated with autoscale min. Pricing impact ~ +30% on the Dedicated quote.
jen_legal: @kevin please send the exact KMS wording you want in the contract. We prefer "Customer retains sole control over key material; Redwood stores only wrapped keys and cannot access plaintext."
maria: Thanks @sam_s @lucas @jen_legal — Kevin, can you assemble that snippet and tag me? I'll drop into HealthCo thread.
kevin: Will do, ETA 30m.
anya: @lucas noted on SLO cost. Can we get a quick sketch of cost delta by EOD? If not, tell me the minimum we need to promise now.
lucas: I'll pull numbers and post here in ~2 hours. For now tell NovaRetail min config: 2x reserved replicas, Q4 GPU family, quantized model variant.
deploy-bot: build #8935 deployed to staging (ci/infra) :white_check_mark:
maria: Small ask for Sales ops — does anyone have an exported SOC2 compliance summary we can share with prospects (one-pager)? @_jen_legal
jen_legal: Yes — I'll share the SOC2 summary PDF and a short FAQ in 10m.
sam_s: Also FYI — for BYOK proofs we can provide a short architecture diagram + KMS audit log sample (sanitized). Ping me if HealthCo asks for logs.
maria: Awesome. If no other blockers I'll follow up with HealthCo and NovaRetail after Kevin's snippet and Lucas's cost. Thanks all :thumbsup:
